objective: Automatically upgrade the lifecycle for large or high-risk tasks. Escalation is triggered BY the admission decision (deterministic), never by the runtime guessing. Escalation is MONOTONIC — once elevated, only verifiable counter-evidence (controller-approved for CRITICAL) may lower it, and never below the original tier.

escalationMeasures.decomposition_requirement: HIGH/CRITICAL and L/XL require mandatory decomposition with explicit phase boundaries; CRITICAL additionally requires controller pre-approval of the decomposition plan
escalationMeasures.research_gate: research_first_required: a read-only discovery phase (or memory retrieval) must complete BEFORE any mutation; its output feeds a bounded refinement of size/risk (never during execution)
escalationMeasures.parallel_readonly_workers: L/XL may fan out parallel read-only discovery nodes; writers remain strictly serialized by the single-writer lease
escalationMeasures.writer_serialization: exactly one writer at a time; lease fail-closed
escalationMeasures.durable_execution: durable_execution_required + checkpoint_resume_required; admission result frozen into the checkpoint fingerprint (anti-drift)
escalationMeasures.checkpointing: checkpoints at every safe boundary; resume reconstructs ready set; interrupted writer -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED (never replayed)
escalationMeasures.independent_review: independent_review_required for every writer phase; strict-reviewer routing for HIGH/CRITICAL (existing isStrictReviewRisk)
escalationMeasures.bounded_repair: repair_budget bounded (HIGH/CRITICAL = 1; L/XL = 2; never above effective_repair_cap)
escalationMeasures.evidence_requirements: evidence_level persistent; harness-owned evidence; secret scan strict
escalationMeasures.external_review: external_review_required at closeout; single authoritative review bundle (one-card-one-review-surface)
controller_intervention_points: before any external effect (network write / publish / commit / push / merge / release / seal)
before memory write-back (denied by default; explicit admission only)

specialRules.smallHighRisk: XS/S + HIGH/CRITICAL uses the FULL high/critical profile — size does NOT lower risk (R3 separation)
specialRules.selfModification: any task modifying admission/scheduler/authority/governance code is CRITICAL-class (RS.SELF_MODIFICATION) and requires explicit admission authorization; the admission runtime itself may not be modified by the task it admits (NEG11)
specialRules.escalationRecording: every escalation and its trigger signals are recorded in the admission result (explainable; telemetry-measurable)
specialRules.overkillGuard: escalation adds WEIGHT only when triggered; a large LOW-risk task gets decomposition+durable but NOT strict review or external review (avoid reporting-driven overkill — Exit Criterion 10)
